supports: E.T1–E.T2 provide actual forgetful/restriction maps. For the plain small étale topos of M0,4 the automorphism group is the explicit generic Galois group preserving all point-inertia classes, with an infinite cyclic kernel on finite local systems. For the algebraic Qbar-scheme the automorphism group is S3. The arithmetic exact sequence forces the bar in these scans to mean geometric base change, and gives no stable-compactification identification.
